correctness.rationale: The exact formula D(n)/n=sum e_p/p reduces the two allowed support sizes to elementary Diophantine equations. Prime powers give a=p-1. On support {p,q}, setting A=a+1 and B=b+1 gives Aq+Bp=pq+1. The p=2 case is impossible by parity plus Aq>2q+1. For odd p, 2<=A<=p-1 and Aq=1 mod p, giving a unique inverse residue; B is then forced and B>=2 by the contradiction q(p-A)=p-1 if B=1. Substitution proves the converse. The squarefree and density corollaries follow exactly as stated. Finite verification is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The equality \(D(n)=\varphi(n)\) compares two canonical arithmetic functions with distinct factorization behavior. The \(\omega(n)\le2\) layer is the first complete nontrivial support stratum. The result is not a bounded census: it gives an unbounded support-level existence criterion, unique exponents, a parity obstruction, the exact squarefree solution, and a prime-support density consequence. These structural outputs can guide any study of higher-support solutions.
